description: FOOD-specific rule specifications for the authoritative rule architecture. These are SPECIFICATIONS only — they are NOT auto-applied. An admin adds them through the existing rule-sync / registry-insert path (repo.insert_registry_entry / insert_rule_version / insert_applicability), which keeps the seeded LMPC Rule 6 history immutable. The existing cosmetic CHK-VEG-NONVEG rule is never overwritten; food products use CHK-VEG-NONVEG-FOOD instead.
